title: Commit or Ignore
prompt: Implement `should_commit(path)` returning true for files a professional C++ repo commits: `src/main.cpp`, `include/app.hpp`, `CMakeLists.txt`, `README.md`, `.gitignore` → true; `build/CMakeCache.txt`, `main.o`, `finance` (binary), `cmake-build-debug/x` → false (generated artifacts).

tests.name: objects ignored
tests.hint: Object files never enter version control.

tests.name: binary ignored
tests.hint: Compiled binaries are artifacts, not sources.
